ui_defaults.optionalDesc: Choose your Divine Order at level 1
ui_defaults.subclassDesc: Chosen at level 1. Divine Orders split clerics between front-line and back-line roles.
ui_defaults.featDesc: General Feats fill your ASI slots. Origin Feats come from your Background.
ui_defaults.backgroundNote: In 2024 D&D, your Background sets ability scores (+2/+1) and grants an Origin Feat. Wisdom is non-negotiable.
ui_defaults.multiclassNote: Clerics can multiclass well with many classes, but the healing focus works best alone.
ui_defaults.weaponNote: Clerics don't get Weapon Mastery slots. Simple or martial weapons depending on Divine Order.
ui_defaults.armorNote: Clerics are proficient in light, medium, and (if Protector) heavy armor, plus shields.
